description: This file defines an OpenCart admin controller class for managing stock statuses in the localization module. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, saving, and deleting stock status entries, along with handling the corresponding views and permissions.

classes.name: StockStatus
classes.description: Controller class handling CRUD operations for stock statuses within the admin localisation module of OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point to display the list of stock statuses, handle sorting, pagination, and loading the list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list view of stock statuses, with sorting and pagination applied.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML for the list of stock statuses based on current filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a stock status, pre-filling data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create or update a stock status entry, returning JSON results.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of selected stock statuses and returns the operation result as JSON.
